content.comment_body: Good morning, I have a [product_name] where I created a web page using [product_name] and saved it to the memory card. After connecting via VPN through the [product_name] module and logging into the custom web page, it stays on the loading screen as shown in the attached image. Regards

Hello, Loading a custom web page with a [product_name] and [version_no] may take a considerable amount of time due to encryption. I do not have extensive experience with the [product_name], but it might take even longer when opening the page for the first time. Once fully loaded, performance should improve due to caching in your browser. Please wait and observe the outcome. Hope this helps.
After leaving it overnight, the website still didn’t work. Can anyone offer assistance?
The issue was resolved by restoring factory settings and reinstalling everything along with the new web page on the memory card. It appears the controller retained the previously programmed site.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter lengthy loading times for custom web pages created with [product_name] and accessed remotely via VPN using the [product_name] communication module. The initial load is especially slow, potentially due to encryption or browser caching, and in some cases the page does not load at all. Resetting the device to factory settings and reinstalling the new web page cured the problem, indicating that prior cached configurations might have interfered.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the custom web interface to load quickly and dependably when accessed remotely via VPN, similar to local access. Any updates to web content should be immediately reflected after deployment.
